rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an idea or plan put forward for consideration.

example.english: We put forward a proposition for everyone to consider.
example.traditional: 我哋提出咗一個建議，等大家一齊諗吓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 gin3 ji5 dang2 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nam2 haa5

rows.note: Use this when the proposition means the terms offered in a business transaction.

example.english: The proposition in this contract is too harsh for us to accept.
example.traditional: 呢份合約嘅交易條件太苛刻，我哋唔會接受。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 gaau1 jik6 tiu4 gin2 taai3 ho1 hak1 ngo5 dei6 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an unsolicited suggestion or request for sex, not for an ordinary suggestion.

example.english: That stranger actually made a sexual proposition to me, so I left immediately.
example.traditional: 嗰個陌生人竟然向我提出性要求，我即刻走人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 mak6 sang1 jan4 ging2 jin4 hoeng3 ngo5 tai4 ceot1 sing3 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 zik1 hak1 zau2 jan4
